title: PACS Registry
description: Schema for the YAML registry block inside AGENTS.md. Each top-level key is a PACS code (PACS0001, PACS0002, etc.) mapping to its invariant definition.

anchor.description: File and symbol where the tag lives, e.g. 'src/engine.js:UNITS'

sync_with.description: Every distant touch-point that has to change together

fails_silently.description: The concrete wrong behavior if the coupling is missed

justification.description: One sentence, concrete, naming the actual consequence. Must be specific to this coupling.

verify.description: Optional executable predicate. Path to a script (relative to project root). Exit 0 = pass, non-zero = fail.

kind.description: Optional classification: registry, message-contract, constant, convention, determinism

retired.description: Set to true when the invariant is removed. The code number is never reused.
